name: epub-converter
description: Epub — Convert ebooks without the clutter.

scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w @epub/web" "npm run dev -w @epub/api"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @epub/shared && npm run build -w @epub/web && npm run build -w @epub/api
scripts.build:web: npm run build -w @epub/shared && npm run build -w @epub/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @epub/shared && npm run typecheck -w @epub/web && npm run typecheck -w @epub/api
